title: Almost-wise random-bit count
statement: Let $k,n,a,b$ be natural numbers satisfying $1\le k\le n$, $a>0$, and $2a\le b$. The associated random-bit count is twice the field degree of the small-bias input determined by these parameters.
caveat: The supplied statement refers to a small-bias input and its field degree, but does not define that input or explain how it is determined by the parameters.
